parts.name: Container
parts.description: bounded surface that scopes the feedback; carries severity styling

parts.name: Severity icon
parts.description: leading glyph that conveys info, success, warning, or error

parts.name: Title (optional)
parts.description: short summary line; required for full-page error and maintenance states

parts.name: Body text
parts.description: the explanation; identifies what happened and the recommended next step

parts.name: Actions (optional)
parts.description: link or button that resolves or acknowledges the message

parts.name: Dismiss control (optional)
parts.description: close affordance for transient or user-dismissible variants

parts.name: Loader shape (skeleton/loader subset)
parts.description: placeholder geometry with optional progress indicator and label

patterns.note: transient feedback enters with a short slide-and-fade, dwells, and dismisses; timing from motion foundations
shimmer or pulse loop while content is pending; loop pauses when content resolves
severity changes (e.g., warning to error within a persistent banner) cross-fade icon and surface color without remounting the container

requirements.title: Role assignment
requirements.body: errors and high-severity feedback use `role="alert"`; informational status uses `role="status"`; static empty/error states are headings plus body, not alerts

requirements.title: Live region politeness
requirements.body: errors are `aria-live="assertive"`; success and info are `aria-live="polite"`; never `assertive` for low-severity status

requirements.title: Focus management on transient vs persistent
requirements.body: transient toasts do not steal focus; persistent banners and full-page states move focus to the heading or first action when surfaced

requirements.title: Accessible action labels
requirements.body: action labels describe the resolution ("Retry", "Dismiss"), not the visual ("Click here"); action and dismiss are distinguishable

requirements.title: Dismiss keyboard support
requirements.body: dismiss controls are reachable from keyboard; Escape closes user-dismissible toasts and banners when focus is within them

requirements.title: Color independence for severity
requirements.body: severity is conveyed by icon plus text in addition to color; never color alone
